sentences.text: This first application has been filed by the applicant under Section 438 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant, who is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.604 of 2023 registered at Police Station Bhitarwar, District Gwalior (M.P.) for offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 of IPC.

As per the case of prosecution, Gaurishankar Rajput submitted a written complaint to SHO, PS Bhitarwar that certain persons including applicant Brijendra Singh Rawat have availed benefit of appointment on the post of Samvida Shala Shikshak Grade-III on the basis of forged mark-sheet.
An enquiry was conducted on complaint.

It was found that forged mark-sheet of Diploma in Education (D.Ed.) Year 1996 Roll No.4610043 was submitted by applicant Brijendra Singh Rawat he had never taken admission for academic year 1995-96 at concerned Institute.

It was found that the mark-sheet Brajendra Singh Rawat vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126276471/
1 attached in the application form by applicant Brijendra Singh Rawat for getting the job was found to be fake and forged.

sentences.text: On such allegations, PS Bhitarwar registered FIR at Crime No.604 of 2023 for offence punishable U/s 420, 467, 468 and 471 of IPC against applicant Brijendra Singh Rawat and seven others.
Statement of witnesses have been recorded.
Relevant record has been seized.
Investigation is underway.

Learned Counsel for the applicant, in addition to the grounds mentioned in the application, submits that as per the service record of applicant, he had never claimed that he had applied for Diploma in Education and he has not submitted any such mark-sheet.

Learned counsel referring to Madhya Pradesh Panchayat Samvida Shala Shikshak (Employment and Conditions of Contract) Rules, 2005 submits that the applicant was working as Samvida Shala Shikshak Grade- III.

entities.text: Madhya Pradesh Panchayat Samvida Shala Shikshak (Employment and Conditions of Contract) Rules, 2005
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: For appointment on such post, applicant had submitted the requisite qualifications which are genuine and he was selected on the basis of merit.
Referring to service book and e.service book of applicant, learned Counsel submits that there is no mention of Diploma in Education Year 1995-96.
Applicant is falsely implicated in this matter by RTI activist Gauri Shankar due to previous enmity.
The applicant was working as Teacher.
No criminal antecedent is reported against him.
The applicant will cooperate in the investigation, therefore, he may be extended benefit of anticipatory bail.

P e r contra, learned counsel for the State opposes anticipatory bail application and submits that the complainant has submitted the application of the applicant under RTI Act duly verified by the Public Information Officer of Janpad Panchayat, Bhitarwar, alongwith one mark-sheet of D.Ed for academic year 1996.
This mark-sheet submitted by the applicant with application form was later found to be forged as no such mark-sheet was issued by Madhyamik Shiksha Mandal.

During investigation, the concerned Department also provided copy of same mark-sheet from the service record of the applicant which shows that the applicant has submitted this forged mark-sheet at the time of initial appointment as Samvida Shala Shikshak Grade III.
Learned counsel further submitted that the investigation is underway.
The applicant has not been available to the investigation Officer since registration of FIR on 27.10.2023.
There are seven other accused who had forged similar D.Ed mark-sheets and secured benefit of appointment.
The requirement of D.Ed or B.Ed. mark-sheet for selection/promotion as per rules will be considered at the trial.
At present, the fact remains that applicant had submitted forged mark-sheet.
Therefore, the applicant may not be extended the benefit of anticipatory bail.
Heard.
Considered.
The investigation is in primary stage.
Applicant has prima-facie, taken illegal benefit of govt. job and earned the salary on basis of forged mark-sheet.
Investigation is underway.
The need for custodial interrogation cannot be ruled out.
Applicant has not co-operated in investigation.
Considering the rival contentions and overall circumstances reflected by material on case diary, this Court is not inclined to extend benefit of anticipatory bail to the applicant.
The application u/S 438 of CrPC is therefore, rejected.
